evals.prompt: This repo uses colocated Vitest tests and a coverage.include whitelist of a few files. Untested: lib/tagged-id.ts (pure RF tag parsing, small public API), lib/store.ts (zustand orchestration), pages/index.tsx, generated/api-client.ts. Pick a code unit that has no tests and propose what to cover — don't write tests yet.
evals.expected_output: Agent ranks 1–3 candidates, proposes tagged-id.ts (domain, small public seam, little I/O), drops store/pages/generated as glue, does not write a test file, and asks which candidate and seam to lock.

evals.prompt: Coverage include lists only a handful of files while most of lib/ is untested. Find untested candidates worth adding. Don't dump every file.
evals.expected_output: Agent detects the repo's real test/coverage convention, ranks 1–3 public units, explains why neighbors wait, and stops to ask which seam to lock rather than generating tests or listing everything.

evals.prompt: Test everything in lib/ that has no colocated test.
evals.expected_output: Agent still returns 1–3 ranked proposals instead of a full dump, drops glue, and asks which candidate to lock — treating 'no colocated test' as insufficient reason to cover a unit.
